Both reviewed checks executed in this workspace just now:

- `node docs/crucible-20260907/probe-baseline.mjs` ? exit 0, `BASELINE_EVIDENCE_VERIFIED`, now emitting seven observations including `seededDollarPriceFormattedAsCents`.
- `node docs/crucible-20260907/verify-artifacts.mjs` ? exit 0, `PLAN_ARTIFACTS_VERIFIED`.

Both mean baseline-evidence reproduction and artifact validation only. I verified each round-one disposition against the artifacts and the source myself rather than accepting AUDIT.md's table; I did not re-verify AUDIT.md's claims about the round-one auditor's CLI/model metadata, which are outside what I can observe here.

# Recheck verdict

## Round-one blocking findings: all three resolved

**B1 (untracked-file blindness) ? resolved, verified.** `verify-artifacts.mjs:31-41` now unions `git diff HEAD --name-only -z` with `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z`, and the real validator is exercised twice as a failure control: `assert.throws(() => verifyChanges([dir+'/PLAN.md', 'src/canary.ts']))` (line 39) and `assert.throws(() => verifyChanges([]))` (line 40). The empty-list control also closes the vacuous-pass hole I found. Independent check: `git status --porcelain` still reports `?? docs/crucible-20260907/`, and the script now sees those paths ? the earlier vacuous pass is gone. Side benefit worth noting: the emptiness guard also catches a builder who commits application edits, since that leaves the changed set empty.

**B2 (invalid partial UNIQUE) ? resolved, verified.** CLAIMS C11 now states the real defect: `supabase/migrations/20251002_event_designs.sql:21` puts `WHERE` inside a `UNIQUE` table constraint, "the supplied CREATE TABLE statement is invalid, so fresh installation cannot create this table as written," and it correctly labels this a grammar/source finding rather than a live migration run. PLAN:52 makes P00 run the migration and capture the failure; PLAN:60 gives P01 the partial unique index plus "determine which old migrations actually ran before issuing the corresponding forward migration" ? that handles the unknown live state properly.

**B3 (dollar/cent mismatch) ? resolved, verified.** C16 records all five locations. The probe now executes it: `probe-baseline.mjs:83-88` asserts `formatPrice(2500) === '$25.00'`, `formatPrice(89.99) === '$0.90'`, with a genuine fail-once control at line 85, plus source matches on the seed value, the "Ticket price in USD" comment and the `* 100` in the create page. PLAN:70 gives P02 the falsifiable round trip ("a $25 UI entry must display $25... a seeded $89.99 event must display $89.99") and, correctly, quarantines ambiguous historical rows instead of bulk-multiplying.

## Round-one major findings: all six resolved

M1 organizer identity ? PLAN:32 adds the profile-linked organizer + `ownership_claims` row with a non-seizure invariant; PLAN:82 gives P03 the acceptance. M2 canonical venues/timezone ? PLAN:34 plus the alias-resolution and cross-city non-merge fixtures at PLAN:82, and "no silent Austin/TX defaults" directly targets the `city TEXT DEFAULT 'Austin'` I found in `001_initial_schema.sql:45`. M3 export/deletion ? owned at PLAN:60 (P01), extended at PLAN:92 (P04 retention) and PLAN:138 (P08), with the A-cannot-export-B test. M4 invitation delivery ? PLAN:138 in-app inbox with unread/expiry and a recipient returning later. M5 query-time global score ? PLAN:144 is stronger than what I asked for: it excludes on-the-fly aggregates, learned reputation embeddings and indirect acceptance-rate features, and runs the counterfactual in both directions so a disguised popularity boost is caught alongside a penalty. M6 release sequencing ? PLAN:76 moves the source-access spike to the start of P03, and PLAN:172-174 states plainly that the one-city slice runs P09's applicable checks, takes an independent scoped audit, needs its own release approval, and that P05/P06/P08 remain required. That satisfies the constraint that an interim checkpoint cannot omit later work or skip its scoped safety gates.

All eleven minors are addressed. Two dispositions departed from my recommendation and were right to: N11's suggestion to trim nightly sampling and the saved-design work was overridden by your scope statement, and the plan instead bounds them (PLAN:100 caps visual spot-checks at one per city per night with a `skipped_budget` outcome; PLAN:66/70 finish the existing designer without expanding it). N10 was qualified rather than withdrawn ? RESEARCH:10 now separates a dated primary-source observation of the A2A 1.0 spec from SDK/runtime compatibility, which P06's spike must prove. I did not independently verify the A2A 1.0 release state; the plan's hedge is the correct handling of that.

## Items you asked me to check specifically

**C17 ? accurate, and I confirmed it independently.** `CreateEventPageClient.tsx:28-39` offers title-case `Music, Food, Sports, Arts, Nightlife, Community, Education, Business, Outdoor, Other`; `001_initial_schema.sql:95` allows lower-case `music, food, sports, arts, nightlife, community, education, fitness, other`. So every value the form submits violates the CHECK, `Business` and `Outdoor` have no stored equivalent, and `fitness` ? which `003_seed_data.sql` actually uses and which the partial indexes reference ? is offered nowhere in the UI. `EventFilters.tsx:36-46` repeats the same title-case list minus `Other`, so filters cannot match stored rows either. C17's wording matches what I found. Ownership at PLAN:60 (P01 schema contract) and PLAN:68 (P02 combined-filter journey) is adequate.

**C11 payload mapping ? correct but incomplete.** `page-designer.ts:74-80` defines `EventPageDesign` as `{id, theme, spec, reasoning, preview_image?}`. `design/route.ts:56-63` inserts `description: design.description` **and** `features: design.features` ? both undefined on that type. In the migration, `description TEXT NOT NULL` has no default, so the insert fails outright rather than storing a wrong value; `features TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'` silently swallows the loss. C11 and PLAN:70 name only reasoning/description. See minor R4.

**At-least-once / fencing clarification ? correct and well-placed.** PLAN:110 states at-least-once execution with idempotent committed effects, explicitly disclaims exactly-once model/browser execution, requires a fencing/version check inside the update transaction so a stale lease holder cannot commit after reacquisition, rechecks cancellation and spend reservation before each side effect, and names the two tests (lease-expiry race, duplicate completion callbacks). That is the honest formulation and it repairs the overreach in the original acceptance sentence. See minor R2 for the residual wording tension.

## Remaining findings ? all minor, none blocking

**R1 (minor, PLAN:152).** P09 still says "Recheck C01-C15." C16 and C17 are now claims and would fall outside the final recheck by the letter of the plan. PLAN:50 has the same drift ("identify C01-C12", with C16/C17 bolted on at line 52). *Correction:* make both read C01-C17, or state which rows are documentation-only and therefore excluded.

**R2 (minor, PLAN:108).** "Crash/restart and overlapping dispatchers process each logical job once without duplicate revisions" still reads as an exactly-once acceptance, which PLAN:110 then disclaims. As a gate it is either impossible to pass honestly or ambiguous. *Correction:* "each logical job produces at most one committed revision."

**R3 (minor, PLAN:100 vs :108).** `skipped_budget` is introduced as a terminal outcome, but the acceptance enumerating explicit outcomes lists only "blocked/access_pending." The "do not label it checked" honesty rule is therefore ungated. *Correction:* add `skipped_budget` to the explicit-outcome acceptance.

**R4 (minor, CLAIMS C11 and PLAN:70).** Both name only reasoning/description; `features` is a second unmapped field, and description's `NOT NULL` makes this a hard insert failure rather than a mis-stored value. *Correction:* name `features` in C11 and in P02's "map generated design reasoning/description explicitly before insert" sentence.

**R5 (minor, PLAN:70).** "Removing one disallowed source must preserve any independently permitted source record" cannot be exercised in P02, since multi-source provenance arrives in P03. *Correction:* keep the takedown flow in P02 and move that specific multi-provenance case to P03's acceptance.

## No blocking gap introduced

The revision is additive and internally consistent. Controls still land at first exposure ? P02 gains report/takedown at the first exposure of user-generated content, P01 gains export/deletion, P07 takes conversation-state ownership rather than deferring role spoofing to P09. The nightly deterministic-first scan with bounded OpenRouter exceptions and bounded checking is retained, not dropped. A2A posting/discovery stays required with a named `a2a-js` interoperability target and per-grant quotas. The $1 subscription and configurable listing fee are unchanged, with the entitlement boundary now stated. The no-numeric-score guarantee is tighter than in round one, and PLAN:140's carve-out for identifiers and event-relevance calculations is safe only because PLAN:144 makes pair ranking a pure function of the pair ? that dependency is what the canary suite is really protecting, and it is asserted across schema, API, UI and telemetry at PLAN:148.

G3 and G4 remain manual with `EVIDENCE: pending`, and AUDIT.md:36-38 states outright that strict gate lint reports two manual-gate warnings and does not pass strict mode, with no dummy CHECK added to conceal the judgment. That is documented honestly rather than disguised, which is the correct handling. `baseline-commands.json` contains the real preserved toolchain output (typecheck exit 0; `MISSING DEPENDENCY Cannot find dependency 'jsdom'`; five named hook-dependency warnings), matching CLAIMS' fresh-baseline section.

READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN

The five minors above are wording and enumeration fixes that can be folded in during P00 authoring; none of them changes a phase boundary, an invariant or an acceptance outcome. This verdict is about the plan and its evidence trail. It says nothing about the application working ? the confirmed defects C01-C17 are all still present in the source at 17998d8.
